steps.text: 2. The system shows the map and the list of existing places.
3. The Contributor searches an address. A1, E1.

exceptions.text: E1. Address not found → "No matching address found"; geocoding service error → 503.

steps.text: 4. The system finds the coordinates through the geocoding service (Nominatim, called through the gateway) and places a pin.
5. The Contributor enters the name, place type, description, adds photos (with captions) and recorded audio if any. E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E3. Missing required field → "Please enter the place name" / "Description is required".
E4. Invalid file format (415) or file too large (413).

steps.text: 6. The system (Media) checks and stores the files and returns their URLs.
8. The system (Tour) checks whether the position is inside a forbidden zone. E2.

exceptions.text: E2. The position is inside a forbidden zone → 422 "The position is inside a forbidden zone (<name>), please move it outside".

steps.text: 9. The system saves the place at the end of the list; a place with recorded audio is "human voice", the rest are read with the device's voice.
10. With moderation enabled, the system sends the place to Moderation (place.submitted event) so AI checks the text and photos. E5.

exceptions.text: E5. Place moderation result: rejected by AI → "Rejected" chip with the reason, must be edited; GIF images or images over 3 MB cannot be checked → Warning for the Admin to review; temporary AI error → wait for the system to retry.

steps.text: 11. The system shows the place's moderation status chip.
12. The Contributor repeats to add other places. A2, A3.

exceptions.text: E6. The place / tour does not exist (404) or is not one's own (403).

steps: A1. Drop a pin directly on the map instead of searching an address.
A3. Edit or delete a place (deletion asks for confirmation). E6.
A4. Edit a place of a tour that is pending review / public: the tour goes back to Draft and must be submitted for review again.
A5. Add a place or change a description: the system translates that place again into the enabled secondary languages (UC#12).
